sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Kenya ETA?
sections.text: Kenya replaced its visa system with an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) in January 2024. British passport holders need a Kenya ETA before travelling, applied for online.

sections.heading: Kenya ETA for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports also need a Kenya ETA unless their nationality is exempt. The ETA covers tourism, business visits, transit and visiting family.

sections.heading: Kenya ETA: what you'll need
sections.text: You'll need your passport photo page, a photo, your flight booking and your accommodation details or an invitation. Apply at least 3 days before you travel, and print or save your approval.

sections.heading: Kenya ETA help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Kenya ETA applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Kenya.

faqs.q: Do I need a visa or an ETA for Kenya?
faqs.a: Kenya now uses an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) instead of a visa for most visitors, including British citizens.

faqs.q: How long does a Kenya ETA take?
faqs.a: Usually around 3 working days. Apply well before you travel.

faqs.q: Can you apply for my Kenya ETA for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our online form: upload your passport and we fill in your details, then we complete and check the Kenya ETA application and submit it for you.
